canonicalPlan.sameStorage: project.data.purposeScheme; legacy schemes still readable and executable by legacy path

referenceInputs.template: actual fixed reference image ID; excluded from workpiece unit/ground-truth count

canonicalPlan.operatorGraph: Existing nodes/edges; all branches declared before execution. Nodes have arbitrary Python code, parameters, expected_outputs, justifications; optional parentId up to three engineering levels.

branches.parentLifecycle: Parent own execution facts remain immutable; purpose state aggregates children. External consumers wait for the full parent purpose lifecycle; derived lifecycleDependencies are recorded by compilation and do not pretend to be artifact edges.

metrics.values: required finite string list for enum

rules.defectLabels: optional explicit list of findings/tags; may have multiple values

coverage.fallbackCategoryId: required for fallback; required policy for compound conditions

conflicts.priority: every rule ID once when priority

aggregation.priority: every final category ID once; required to resolve ambiguous multi-condition final outcomes
aggregation.exclusiveFinal: exactly one final product category; aggregation.multilabel is rejected with a question, not silently migrated

APIs.compileScheme(scheme): {ok,errors,questions,order,...}; missing rules/provenance/endpoint ownership yields questions, never inferred human truth
APIs.runDatasetScheme(project,execute,options: One compilation, sequential explicit units; no conversation agent in production loop

options.units: array or async iterable of {id,imageIds,views?,expected?}; default paged metadata traversal of sourceId, one image each
options.signal: AbortSignal; cancellation between-node boundaries; active native worker finishes or times out
options.onProgress: bounded summary containing only latest unit metadata
options.saveUnitResult: awaited callback ({executionId,unit,record,runs,context}); first context has scheme, later context only fingerprint; durable write errors stop dispatch
options.artifactMode: references for durable production; inline retained for legacy small debugging

PythonSDK.normalResult: found(value) or not_found(message) -> execution COMPLETED; valid false is expected missing result
PythonSDK.fault: callback exception -> execution FAULT; dependent invocation skipped, independent invocation continues
PythonSDK.layers: save_layers(id, actual layer array) writes evidence and run.structuredLayers; original-image geometry is preserved
PythonSDK.upstream: upstream[slot].artifact.data for JSON; upstream[slot].image for true hash-verified persisted image bytes
PythonSDK.fixedReferences: execution.referenceInputs binds fixed source images by slot. images/raw_images/image_records contain only the workpiece; references[slot] and reference_records[slot] provide actual reusable reference pixels/provenance.

observations.execution: COMPLETED / FAULT / CANCELLED, independent of category
observations.normalClassification: exactly one result.categoryId (legacy categoryIds contains that one ID); multiple defectLabels do not contribute extra product counts
observations.regression: only human confirmed expected.categoryIds with nonempty provenance.ref enters labelled count; faults never true positive
observations.timing: actual monotonic operator durationMs, node hostExecutionMs, workpiece totalMs; dataset exact completed-unit mean/P50/P95/max; active progress does not invent percentiles
observations.retention: project.datasetExecutions metadata references durable per-unit records; only latest unit output artifacts retained in project memory under durable callback

perCategory.FN: completed known-positive did not predict this category
perCategory.TN: completed known-negative did not predict this category
perCategory.recall: TP/(TP+FN): completed-case recall only, null for zero denominator
perCategory.unavailableExpected: expected-positive FAULT/CANCELLED/unavailable units, excluded from confusion counts
perCategory.endToEndDetectionRate: TP/(completedExpectedPositive+unavailableExpected), attempted-case denominator distinct from completed-case recall

coverage.completed: labelled units with normal valid completed classification
coverage.ratio: completed/labelled, null when no labelled units

regressionMetrics.labelledFaults: fault count independent of product NG; faults never become TP
regressionMetrics.unavailableExpectedByCategory: count of expected-positive unavailable units per category
regressionMetrics.ratesAvailable: derived at terminal emission only; active progress exposes counts and null rates
regressionMetrics.complexity: O(category count) for each unit, no rescanning all unit results
regressionMetrics.noLabels: all precision/recall/FPR/detection ratios null; zero raw counters do not imply 0% or 100% accuracy

exitPartition.counts.exits: partition of all processed units, sum equals processed
exitPartition.counts.evidence: ready/notReady per attempted unit; case matches cannot bypass explanation completeness

limits.noDeploymentClaim: regression observations and complete explanations do not establish industrial acceptance
limits.legacy: legacy all-images node plans remain compatible but are not presented as scalable production runners
limits.cancel: does not yet interrupt in-flight Python on human cancellation; timeout/worker-crash are independently recorded faults
limits.hierarchy: maximum three engineering node levels; graph container and internal operators do not add engineering levels
